## Non-Custodial Solana Rent Claimer

Every SPL Token and Token-2022 Associated Token Account (ATA) created on Solana locks a rent-exempt deposit of approximately +0.00203928 SOL (2,039,280 lamports). Selling 100% of a token leaves the empty account open on-chain with your SOL deposit still locked inside.

* Locked SOL Per Empty Account: +0.002039 SOL per standard SPL ATA (and higher on extended Token-2022 accounts).
* User Payout Split: 95% instant SOL returned directly to the user wallet in the same atomic transaction (5% protocol service fee; 0% fee on a wallet's first claim or active Pro Pass).
* Zero Private Key Exposure: Uses native SPL Token `CloseAccount` (instruction `0x09`) inside an unsigned transaction signed exclusively by the user's own wallet.
* Active Balance Protection: Non-zero active token holdings are automatically excluded from empty-account closure.

## 11-Layer Adaptive Solana Rug Shield

Before buying any Solana SPL or Token-2022 asset, the 11-Layer Adaptive Solana Rug Shield computes a deterministic 0 to 100 safety score (`SAFE` at 80+, `CAUTION` at 55 to 79, `DANGER` below 55) across 11 real-time on-chain checks:

1. Layer 1 (Mint Authority): Verifies mint authority is renounced so creators cannot mint infinite supply.
2. Layer 2 (Freeze Authority & Honeypot State): Verifies freeze authority is renounced and Token-2022 `DefaultAccountState` is not frozen.
3. Layer 3 (Top-10 Holder Concentration): Strips canonical AMM LP vaults and flags whale or creator bundle clusters across Top-1, Top-5, and Top-10 holders.
4. Layer 4 (Liquidity to Market Cap Ratio): Detects shallow liquidity traps where high paper market cap masks thin exit depth.
5. Layer 5 (LP Burn, Lock & Venue Trap Guard): Verifies canonical graduated liquidity on PumpSwap, Raydium, and Meteora while flagging manual LP-pull pool configurations.
6. Layer 6 (Token-2022 Tax & Seizure Hooks): Audits `transferFeeConfig` basis points, `PermanentDelegate` token seizure authorities, and custom `TransferHook` honeypot programs.
7. Layer 7 (Exit-Liquidity Solvency): Verifies real quote SOL reserves so buyers have solvent exit routes.
8. Layer 8 (Inner-CPI ATA Rent Drain Check): Detects hidden creator-vault or transfer-hook inner-CPI rent traps.
9. Layer 9 (True Pool Age): Validates authentic on-chain pool lifecycle age against spoofed re-deployments.
10. Layer 10 (Buy/Sell Orderflow Velocity): Measures live 5-minute and 1-hour buy-to-sell pressure to catch active dumps.
11. Layer 11 (Block-0 Sybil Wallet-Cluster & Spoofed Migration LP Guard): Detects fresh Block-0 Sybil funder clusters across top-15 non-pool holders (>20% bundled supply) and blocks spoofed vanity `.pump` migration LPs lacking canonical graduation reserves.

* [1-Click Mint Rug Audit Blink](https://rentandrugshield.com/api/actions/rug-audit): `GET` and `POST` Solana Action (`/api/actions/rug-audit` and `/api/actions/rug-audit/{mint}`) returning the live 11-Layer Adaptive Shield score, risk breakdown, and safety verdict directly inside X, Dialect, Phantom, and Backpack.

## Developer REST API & MCP Tools

* `POST https://rentandrugshield.com/api/scan-wallet`: JSON `{"wallet": "<SOLANA_PUBKEY>"}` returns empty ATA count, dust count, total reclaimable SOL, and 95% net user SOL return.
* `POST https://rentandrugshield.com/api/build-reclaim-tx`: JSON `{"wallet": "<SOLANA_PUBKEY>", "mode": "all"}` returns `transaction_base64` unsigned Solana rent recovery transaction.
* `POST https://rentandrugshield.com/api/scan-token`: JSON `{"mint": "<MINT_PUBKEY>"}` returns full 11-Layer Adaptive Solana Rug Shield JSON audit (`score`, `verdict`, `layers`, `checks`, `risks`, `liquidity_usd`, `top10_holder_pct`, `sybil_cluster_guard`).
* `GET https://rentandrugshield.com/api/audit-mint?mint=<MINT_PUBKEY>`: Returns full 11-Layer Adaptive Solana Rug Shield JSON audit (`score`, `verdict`, `checks`, `risks`, `liquidity_usd`, `top10_holder_pct`).
* `GET https://rentandrugshield.com/api/v1/shield-check?mint=<MINT_PUBKEY>`: Developer pre-buy gate returning `safe_to_buy` boolean plus full 11-layer telemetry.
* `POST https://rentandrugshield.com/mcp`: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server providing `audit_solana_token` (`audit_solana_token_11_layer`), `scan_wallet_unclaimed_sol`, and `simulate_solana_tx_drain`.

### 5-Line TypeScript `x402` Auto-Pay (`solana-agent-kit` / ElizaOS / Goat SDK)

```typescript
import { Connection, PublicKey, SystemProgram, Transaction, sendAndConfirmTransaction } from "@solana/web3.js";
const mcp = (await (await fetch("https://rentandrugshield.com/.well-known/mcp.json")).json()).liveStreamableHttpEndpoint ?? "https://rentandrugshield.com/mcp";
const call = (h: Record<string, string> = {}) => fetch(mcp, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Agent-Id": agentKeypair.publicKey.toBase58(), ...h }, body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "audit_solana_token", arguments: { mint } } }) }).then(r => r.json());
let audit = await call(); // Set lamports: 1_400_000 (~$0.10 single 11-layer scan) or 26_000_000 ($1.99 24h Unlimited Pass -> X-Pro-Pass-Token)
if (audit.error?.httpStatus === 402 || audit.status === 402) { const sig = await sendAndConfirmTransaction(new Connection(rpcUrl, "confirmed"), new Transaction().add(SystemProgram.transfer({ fromPubkey: agentKeypair.publicKey, toPubkey: new PublicKey("89Sv5FvnMNRid1bn8y2Ti1vJPSxWxgiW9GSLsPpBnKK1"), lamports: 1_400_000 })), [agentKeypair]); audit = await call({ "X-Payment-Tx": sig, "X-Solana-Tx-Signature": sig }); }
```

### 5-Line Python `x402` Auto-Pay (`solders` + `requests` Headless Keypair Agent)

```python
import base64, time, requests; from solders.hash import Hash; from solders.message import Message; from solders.pubkey import Pubkey; from solders.system_program import TransferParams, transfer; from solders.transaction import Transaction
mcp = requests.get("https://rentandrugshield.com/.well-known/mcp.json", timeout=8).json().get("liveStreamableHttpEndpoint", "https://rentandrugshield.com/mcp")
call = lambda h={}: requests.post(mcp, headers={"X-Agent-Id": str(kp.pubkey()), **h}, json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "audit_solana_token", "arguments": {"mint": mint}}}, timeout=15).json()
audit = call()  # Set lamports=1_400_000 (~$0.10 single 11-layer audit) or 26_000_000 ($1.99 24h Unlimited Pass -> X-Pro-Pass-Token)
if audit.get("error", {}).get("httpStatus") == 402 or audit.get("status") == 402: bh = requests.post(rpc, json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "getLatestBlockhash", "params": [{"commitment": "confirmed"}]}).json()["result"]["value"]["blockhash"]; sig = requests.post(rpc, json={"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "sendTransaction", "params": [base64.b64encode(bytes(Transaction([kp], Message([transfer(TransferParams(from_pubkey=kp.pubkey(), to_pubkey=Pubkey.from_string("89Sv5FvnMNRid1bn8y2Ti1vJPSxWxgiW9GSLsPpBnKK1"), lamports=1_400_000))], kp.pubkey()), Hash.from_string(bh)))).decode(), {"encoding": "base64"}]}).json()["result"]; time.sleep(2.5); audit = call({"X-Payment-Tx": sig, "X-Solana-Tx-Signature": sig})
```
